title: W10 fix incomplete: CI PP_DEBUG gate compiles only the app — harness/overlay.odin and the overlay-check dispatch remain compile-uncovered
evidence:
ci.yml:99-104:
      # Story 5.7 (W10, Perkins r1): the PP_DEBUG overlay build must stay
      # compile-green in CI — two whole files rot silently otherwise. The
      # overlay is compile-gated, so this build also proves the gate itself
      # holds (the plain build above proves the release shape).
      - name: PP_DEBUG overlay build (compile gate)
        run: odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin

harness/overlay.odin:23: `when #config(PP_DEBUG, false) {` (whole file body, closes at :139)
harness/main.odin:82: `when #config(PP_DEBUG, false) {` (the overlay-check verb dispatch)

ci.yml contains no `odin build harness ... -define:PP_DEBUG` anywhere (grep: 0 hits; the only harness builds go through tools/harness.sh, which builds without the define).
detail: r1 W10 named debug_overlay.odin, harness/overlay.odin, and the D toggle as un-covered PP_DEBUG code. The r2 gate compiles the app package graph only — harness/overlay.odin and the PP_DEBUG dispatch in harness/main.odin still compile EMPTY in every CI build, so a future edit breaking them passes all checks. The new comment's own rationale ('two whole files rot silently otherwise') is only half-addressed. Verified the PP_DEBUG harness build compiles green at this sha (ODIN_ROOT=tools/raylib-sw/shadow odin build harness -debug -define:PP_DEBUG=true, and overlay-check runs) — the gap is coverage, not a break.
recommended_fix: Add a CI step building the harness with the define, e.g. `ODIN_ROOT=tools/raylib-sw/shadow odin build harness -out:bin/harness-debug -debug -define:PP_DEBUG=true` (the shadow is already built by tools/harness.sh in an earlier step).

title: App stats builder + header initialized unconditionally with no consumer when --stats-out absent; the justifying comment contradicts the nil-sb path
detail: When stats_live is false, stats_emit receives nil sb, so nothing ever appends through the builder — the comment's stated reason ('the overlay appends … via stats_emit even without --stats-out') describes the nil path that never touches it. The unconditional header write allocates ~500 default-allocator bytes that the stats_live-gated defer never frees (r1's conditional init was tighter). Benign at process exit, but the ownership asymmetry and misleading comment invite future misuse.
recommended_fix: Restore the r1 conditional init (`if app.stats_live { builder_make + stats_write_header }`), or delete the incorrect comment sentence; either way the always-allocated/conditionally-freed asymmetry disappears.
